name: ptz-cam-control
description: PTZ camera control and multiview for 4 PTZOptics cameras

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/ffmpeg-check.js win32 && electron-builder --win portable --x64 && node scripts/ffmpeg-check.js win32 --packaged
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/ffmpeg-check.js darwin && electron-builder --mac dir && node scripts/ffmpeg-check.js darwin --packaged

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: PTZ Cam Control talks to the PTZ cameras on your local network (video, pan/tilt/zoom and settings).
